summary: Iteration 12 (Studio hub + Services CRUD + Responsive foundation) — Backend 100% PASS (15/15 new tests in test_iteration12_studio.py + 170 regression = 185/185, ~72s). Frontend 13/14 spec flows PASS at 390x844 and 320x680 mobile viewports. ONE FUNCTIONAL BUG found — Step 7 'Remove' button on /pro/services does not actually remove the service; the row remains visible as INACTIVE. Root cause: backend DELETE /hairdressers/me/services/{sid} performs a soft-delete (sets active:false) while GET /hairdressers/me/services returns ALL rows regardless of active. So Remove and Toggle-off produce the identical visual result (both show INACTIVE badge, row stays). This is confusing UX — customers expect Remove to delete. RCA and fix suggestions in rca_of_issue below. All other spec items verified: (1) 4-tab layout (Dashboard/Bookings/Growth/My Studio) with correct icons and initial route dashboard; (2) setup-banner shows '80%' + 'Next up: Services & Pricing' when amara has no services; (3) banner tap → /pro/studio?focus=services with brief highlight animation on services row (Animated.sequence on borderColor+bg); (4) studio-services row → /pro/services; (5) Add service modal (18 style chips visible, price/duration/lengths fields, save button) creates a service and modal closes; (6) Switch toggle flips active with INACTIVE badge appearing; (8) /pro/studio-info bio textarea + Save changes works without error; (9) Bookings tab renders Today + Upcoming sections; (10) Growth tab renders Business Success Score 87 Excellent for amara; (11) Sign out from /pro/studio → /welcome; (13) 320x680 responsive — scrollWidth==clientWidth (no horizontal overflow) on dashboard AND /pro/studio, banner text wraps cleanly, all 4 tab labels remain visible/readable; (14) setup-banner routes to /pro/studio (NOT /pro/onboarding) — the redirect-trap fix from iter11 remains intact and 'Improve My Studio' is no longer forcing onboarding. New backend endpoints verified: GET /hairdressers/me (200 with bio/salon_name), GET /hairdressers/me/studio-status (5 sections, first_incomplete='services' pre-create, progress {done:4,total:5,percent:80}; after service create, first_incomplete flips to a different key and services.complete=true), POST /services/{sid}/toggle flips active bool, GET /studios/{hid}/services public (no auth) returns row; active_only=true (default) hides inactive; active_only=false includes it. Regression: onboarding-status + onboarding-complete unchanged. Non-hairdresser (sara) → 403 on /hairdressers/me/studio-status AND /hairdressers/me. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch in changed files). No red-screen or console errors. Only observable console noise: react-native-web deprecation warnings for shadow* style props and props.pointerEvents (framework-level, not app code).

minor.issue: Soft-delete only — sets active:false but the row is not removed and GET /hairdressers/me/services still returns it. Combined with the Toggle endpoint producing the same effect, users cannot actually remove a service. Recommend: either hard-delete the doc (db.professional_services.delete_one) OR add a deleted_at marker and exclude those from the list query. Also missing role check — a non-hairdresser could hit the endpoint (query is scoped by user.id so no data leak, but should still return 403 for role != 'hairdresser' for consistency).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Remove' (testID svc-del-{id}) does not remove the service from the list — the row remains visible with an INACTIVE badge, identical to tapping the Switch off. Users have no way to permanently delete a service.

action_items: Fix Remove-service semantics: change DELETE /api/hairdressers/me/services/{sid} to actually delete the doc (db.professional_services.delete_one({'id': sid, 'hairdresser_id': user.id})) — the current soft-delete makes Remove indistinguishable from Toggle-off. Alternatively keep soft-delete but exclude inactive from GET /hairdressers/me/services when a `?include_inactive=false` (default) flag is used, and have the frontend confirm hard-delete via a modal.
Add role check (user.role == 'hairdresser' → else 403) to DELETE /api/hairdressers/me/services/{sid} for consistency with the other /hairdressers/me/* endpoints.
Optional: Consider adding an explicit 'Delete permanently' confirmation dialog in services.tsx onDelete handler to prevent accidental data loss once hard-delete is enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:1885 first_incomplete correctly uses `next((s['key'] for s in sections if not s['complete']), None)` — order preserved so availability is checked before services which is checked before portfolio, matching the onboarding priority.
backend/server.py:1911-1918 GET /studios/{hid}/services correctly public (no auth dep) and defaults active_only=True — good separation from the /hairdressers/me/services owner endpoint.

backend/server.py:1988-2015 upsert_service checks for existing (hairstyle_id, active:True) doc and updates in place; nice — prevents duplicate active services for the same style. Note: since soft-deleted services still exist with active=false, a re-add of the same style will create a NEW doc (not resurrect the old one). Acceptable, but combined with the Remove bug means the DB accumulates zombie inactive docs.
frontend/app/pro/_layout.tsx:70 onboarding tab correctly hidden via `href: null` AND `tabBarStyle: {display: 'none'}` — tab bar disappears during onboarding as expected.

frontend/app/pro/studio.tsx:79-95 maybeFocus uses focusedOnce ref + setTimeout(250ms) to avoid double-firing during layout; Animated.sequence pulses borderColor+backgroundColor on the targeted row. Clean.

frontend/app/pro/services.tsx:84 onDelete calls DELETE then load() but load() will return the same row (still in DB with active:false) — the reload does not remove it visually. This is the source of the Remove bug.
frontend/app/pro/dashboard.tsx:72 setup-banner correctly routes to `/pro/studio?focus=${first_incomplete}` (never `/pro/onboarding`) — the iter11 redirect-trap fix remains intact.
Minor: services.tsx:39-42 loads services + hairstyles in Promise.all — good. Consider caching hairstyles between mounts since they're global.

Minor: studio.tsx:186 'Business Success Score' card doesn't have onPress even though it has a chevron; only 'See all →' at the section title deep-links. Consider making the whole card pressable for consistency.

rca_of_issue: P1 bug — Services 'Remove' has no effect. **Reproduction**: (1) sign in as amara@braids.demo; (2) go to /pro/services; (3) tap Add service → pick style, price 100, duration 60 → Create; (4) row appears; (5) tap Remove; (6) EXPECTED: row disappears (list becomes empty). ACTUAL: row persists with 'INACTIVE' badge, count now '0 active · 1 total'. **Root cause**: backend/server.py:2017-2022 DELETE endpoint calls `db.professional_services.update_one({...}, {'$set': {'active': False}})` — this is a soft-delete. Meanwhile backend/server.py:1976-1986 GET endpoint queries `db.professional_services.find({'hairdresser_id': user.id})` with NO active filter. So the row is returned in the reload and re-rendered. Same visual outcome as toggling the Switch off. **Mitigation options**: (a) change DELETE to hard-delete: `await db.professional_services.delete_one({'id': sid, 'hairdresser_id': user.id})` — simplest, matches user intent; (b) keep soft-delete but add a `deleted_at` field and exclude from GET (allows undo/audit); (c) filter `active:True` in GET by default with an `?include_inactive=true` opt-in — but this collides with the Toggle-off flow (inactive services would vanish from the pro's own list). Recommended: option (a). Also add role check to DELETE for consistency.
